Workshop: Comparative Morphological Parsing & Lemmatization

Overview: In this workshop, you will parse a 20-word excerpt of your primary manuscript witness across three distinct tiers: (1) manual philological parse using a scholarly lexicon; (2) deterministic NLP tagging with CLTK or TreeTagger; and (3) zero-shot LLM parsing. You will compare accuracy, document edge cases, and build a TEI linguistic XML fragment.

Deadlines: Comparison Post due Friday by 11:00 PM; Peer Reviews due Monday by 11:00 PM.
